questions.nlq: Hey there! So I'm putting together this whole report on our team's department history for last year and I'm kinda lost on how to get everything right. Could you help me dig up all the staff members who were in departments during 2017, along with their department assignments and maybe figure out who had the most roles? I need the dates when their assignments happened - that's super important for tracking.

meanings.hidden_knowledge: When I ask about 'dates when their assignments happened' I mean the beginning of each assignment - when they first started working in each department. I need to track when people joined each department role.
meanings.gt_sql:
SELECT 
    s.staff_name,
    d.department_name,
    sda.date_assigned_from
FROM Staff_Department_Assignments sda
JOIN Staff s ON sda.staff_id = s.staff_id
JOIN Departments d ON sda.department_id = d.department_id
WHERE (
    (sda.date_assigned_from >= '2017-01-01' AND sda.date_assigned_from <= '2017-12-31')
    OR 
    (sda.date_assigned_from < '2017-01-01' AND (sda.date_assigned_to IS NULL OR sda.date_assigned_to >= '2017-01-01'))
)
ORDER BY s.staff_name, sda.date_assigned_from;

meanings.hidden_knowledge: When I ask about 'dates when their assignments happened' I actually mean the end of each assignment - when they stopped working in each department. I need to track when people left each department role to understand turnover patterns.

    JOIN Order_Items oi ON co.order_id = oi.order_id

        ca.customer_id,
        a.address_details,

    FROM Customer_Addresses ca
    JOIN Addresses a ON ca.address_id = a.address_id
    WHERE ca.date_to IS NULL
)

       COUNT(o.order_id) AS total_orders,
       MAX(o.order_date) AS most_recent_order_date
FROM Customers c
JOIN Customer_Orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
WHERE c.payment_method_code LIKE '4%'
  AND strftime('%Y', o.order_date) = '2018'
GROUP BY c.customer_email
ORDER BY total_orders DESC;

questions.nlq: Could you tell me which staff members work in departments with 'resource' in their name, and show me their average assignment duration grouped by store chain?

SELECT 
    dsc.dept_store_chain_name,
    AVG(CAST(julianday('now') - julianday(sda.date_assigned_from) AS INTEGER)) AS avg_assignment_duration_days
FROM Staff_Department_Assignments sda
JOIN Departments d ON sda.department_id = d.department_id
JOIN Department_Stores ds ON d.dept_store_id = ds.dept_store_id
JOIN Department_Store_Chain dsc ON ds.dept_store_chain_id = dsc.dept_store_chain_id
WHERE d.department_name LIKE '%resource%'
    AND sda.date_assigned_to IS NULL
GROUP BY dsc.dept_store_chain_id
